shadows.name: shot
shadows.purpose: Clip frames on work rows; 0.6rem on hover.

components.name: Section head
components.description: Full-width band opening each section: display word and a counted meta cell.
components.css: .ds-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;background:#ff4d1a;color:#120e0c;border-bottom:2px solid #120e0c;text-transform:lowercase}.ds-head h2{margin:0;padding:1rem;font:800 3rem/0.95 Unbounded,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-0.06em}.ds-head p{display:grid;gap:.4rem;margin:0;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-left:2px solid #120e0c}.ds-head b{font:800 2rem/0.9 Unbounded,sans-serif;color:#fffaf5}.ds-head span{font:500 .8rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}

components.name: Contact card
components.description: Orange card with a hard ink shadow; lifts on hover, sinks on press.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Underlined inline word that inverts on hover.

keyCharacteristics: signal-orange ground, ink and cream only for the site's own surfaces
2px ink rules between everything, zero radius
hard offset shadows, zero blur; hover lifts off the shadow, press sinks into it
three-face type system: display, serif, mono

rules.name: The Three Colour Rule
rules.body: The site's own surfaces use only orange, ink and cream. A new colour enters only as another product's brand, on that product's row.

rules.name: The Borrowed Brand Rule
rules.body: A row about a product sets --row-bg, --row-fg and --row-accent from that product's palette; layout rules never name a colour.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has zero blur. Hover lifts an element off its shadow; :active sinks it back.
